description: [Parkings GPS] Taux d'occupation des places monitorées avril 2026 is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by UPCITI / Grand Paris Sud. Ce fichier regroupe les statistiques d'occupation des parkings sur le territoire. Les données de ces parkings sont remontées suite au déploiements de capteurs à la place de la société UPCITI qui en garantit l'exactitude. Le jeu de données est structuré pour couvrir un cycle complet d'une semaine type. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are Parking, upciti, capteurs, place. The portal shows 1,680 records. The portal shows 2026-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
